en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's study
I'm getting sleepy...
Sure is dusty in here
Yes, that is a good attitude.

Among the people I have served, the most
successful ones never neglected their studies.

Someday, you will become the best
detective...
I can imagine such a future...
I do not mind if you wish to sleep.

If you wish to resist sleep, then I can
take actions to help you.

I can serve you caffeine, hand you medicine,
or even wake you up with pain...
Please make your choice.

Yes... The dust never disappears regardless
of how often I clean.

There may be a problem with the
rooms' structures...

If discussing this puts you into an unpleasant
mood, then I will restrain myself.

My apologies.
I did not mean to put you in a bitter mood.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
